name: water-routine-qc-team

displayDescription.en: Coordinates evidence extraction, report audit, process-record audit and adjudication for water routine-element test reports, with span-level traceability.
displayDescription.zh: 面向水常规元素检测报告，聚合证据抽取、报告审核、过程记录审核与裁定，输出可回溯到原文的质控结论。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按项目组织一次水常规元素检测报告质控：先抽证据，再并行审报告和过程记录，最后裁定并输出可高亮原文的审核报告。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Run quality control for a water routine-element report batch: extract evidence, audit report and process records in parallel, then adjudicate with span-level traceability.

quickPrompts.zh: 按项目组织一次水常规元素检测报告质控：先抽证据，再并行审报告和过程记录，最后裁定并输出可高亮原文的审核报告。
quickPrompts.en: Run quality control for a water routine-element report batch: extract evidence, audit report and process records in parallel, then adjudicate with span-level traceability.

quickPrompts.zh: 这份报告包缺采样方案/现场记录/交接记录，先列缺件，再决定哪些能判、哪些只能待补。
quickPrompts.en: This bundle lacks the sampling plan, field records and handover records. List missing items first, then decide what can be judged and what must wait.

quickPrompts.zh: 标准库里 GB 11893、HJ 535、HJ 636、HJ 84 的规则是否齐？缺哪个先告诉我，不要自己抽标准。
quickPrompts.en: Check whether GB 11893, HJ 535, HJ 636 and HJ 84 rule sets are ready in the global library; do not extract standards yourself.
